# PAAS-003: Platform panel ports are not open to the world

- **Group:** Coolify and Dokploy
- **Severity when it fails:** high
- **Root:** not needed

## Why it matters

The Coolify panel (8000, plus 6001 and 6002 for realtime and terminal) and the Dokploy panel (3000) grant root on every managed server to whoever logs in, and an unclaimed fresh install lets the first visitor create the admin account. Published Docker ports bypass UFW, so a wildcard listener is reachable unless the Docker chain filters it.

## Verify by hand

```sh
ss -tlnp | grep -E ':(8000|6001|6002|3000) '
```

## How to fix it

Reach the panel over the tailnet or behind an access proxy, and publish its ports on 127.0.0.1 or the tailnet address.

## What a fix can break

Losing the only path to the panel locks you out of it; keep a tailnet path working before closing the public one.
